intro: ENTI is Penn State's intercollege minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation, run out of the College of Engineering's School of Engineering Design and Innovation. It is open to every major. We build the projects; ENTI is where that work turns into credits, and where a weekend hack gets treated like the start of a venture.
reasons: The coursework is the thing we already do on weekends — customer research, prototypes, pitching — with a grade attached.
Open to all ten colleges, so the whole team can take it, not just the engineers.
Finish the sequence and you leave with a minor or a certificate on your transcript, not only a repo.

tracks.name: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
tracks.summary: Three core courses, then three more from one of ten concentration clusters. Engineering students usually take the Product Innovation cluster.

tracks.name: Product Innovation
tracks.summary: The shorter route. One required course plus two from the Product Innovation list — worth taking if the full minor does not fit your schedule.
